scope.summary: Implement table cell formatting over the MT-166 table object: Cell-text (insets, vertical justification, first baseline, clip-to-cell, text rotation 0/90/180/270); Cell-graphic (convert cell to graphic cell holding a placed image with cell inset and fitting, reusing MT-161/MT-162); Cell-strokes/fills (per-side stroke proxy — weight, type, color, tint, gap color, overprint — and cell fill); Cell-rows/columns (row height at-least/exactly, column width, keep-with-next-row, start-row-on-next-frame/page); Cell-diagonal lines (diagonal/crossed lines with stroke settings and draw-in-front/behind); plus alternating patterns (alternating row strokes, column strokes, and fills every-other/every-N/custom with skip-first/skip-last) and header/footer rows (repeat per column/frame/page with skip-first/last; convert body rows to/from header/footer). Formatted through table and cell styles (MT-170).
acceptance_criteria: full cell formatting (text/graphic/strokes/fills/rows/diagonal) + alternating patterns + repeating headers/footers
proof_targets: cell-format render runtime; alternating-pattern + header-repeat test
expected_tests: live: cell text insets/vjustify/rotation, graphic cell, per-side strokes+fill, row height/keep/start-on-next, diagonal lines render
test: alternating row/column strokes+fills (every-N, skip-first/last); repeating header/footer rows

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Table & cell formatting

risk_if_missed: Tables cannot be formatted; unusable for real tabular design.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
